close_reason: Superseded by PKIX-9vnx.7 (commit c0e63477). PKIX-9vnx.7 implemented the broader OSCAL Profile resolver which includes modify.set-parameters handling. The parameter-overrides extractor and LintRunner::apply_parameter_overrides method ship as part of that work in pkix-lint/src/oscal/profile.rs and pkix-lint/src/lib.rs. Round-trip behavior pinned by oscal::profile::tests::end_to_end_profile_override_changes_runner_behavior. Negative tests for unknown control id, unknown param id, malformed Profile shape, and invalid value all present (apply_parameter_overrides_unknown_lint_errors, apply_parameter_overrides_unknown_param_id_errors, apply_parameter_overrides_invalid_value_wraps_parameter_error). All .6.5 acceptance criteria met in .7's implementation; no separate bead needed.
description:
## Why

PKIX-9vnx.6 decomposition step 5. Closes the OSCAL Profile composition story for parameters. OSCAL Profiles can `modify` Controls by overriding their parameter values; this bead wires that to the Lint parameter mechanism from .6.4.

## What

1. New parser in `pkix-lint/src/oscal/parse.rs`:

```rust
pub struct ProfileOverride {
    pub control_id: String,
    pub param_id: String,
    pub new_value: String,
}

pub fn overrides_from_profile(value: &Value) -> Result<Vec<ProfileOverride>, ParseError>
```

Walks an OSCAL Profile JSON Value and extracts `modify.set-parameters[*]` entries; each `set-parameter` references a control + a parameter id + a new value (or label).

2. New function on `LintRunner` (or free):

```rust
pub fn apply_overrides(&mut self, overrides: &[ProfileOverride]) -> Result<(), ApplyError>
```

For each override, find the Lint by control_id and call `set_parameter` on it. Missing control_id or unknown param_id surfaces as ApplyError.

3. Round-trip test:
   - Build LintRunner with Rfc5280MaxSerialLengthLint.
   - Construct a Profile JSON that overrides `max-octets` to 16.
   - Parse + apply.
   - Verify the lint now rejects an 18-octet serial that the default accepted.

4. Profile JSON shape reference: NIST OSCAL Profile model, modify.set-parameters[*].

## Acceptance

- [ ] overrides_from_profile parses set-parameter entries.
- [ ] LintRunner::apply_overrides mutates parametric lints.
- [ ] Round-trip test passes.
- [ ] Negative tests: unknown control_id, unknown param_id, malformed Profile.
- [ ] Full pkix-lint suite passes; `oscal` feature gated.

## Out of scope

- Profile `select / exclude` directives (Catalog subset) — that's separate work (PKIX-9vnx.7 / .8).
- Profile `import` chaining — also out of this bead.

## Depends on

PKIX-9vnx.6.4 (parameter mechanism)
PKIX-9vnx.6.2 (catalog serializer — for sample Profile fixtures that reference real Control ids).
title: OSCAL Profile modify-directive overrides Lint parameters
